fullVoiceover: Did you know your phone relies on orbiting clocks defying Einstein every single second? Most think satellite time adjustments are totally instant and flawless. In reality, gravity shifts time by thirty-eight microseconds daily! Without massive code intervention, navigation fails instantly due to ionosphere drift, clock drift, and orbital decay. This proves space-time is secretly breaking our maps, leaving everyone still asking...
